sheets.title: Vault › New login — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: A new login drafted its website as a * wildcard — offered on every site if saved as drafted — with three lines of wildcard help and a tester under a pattern nobody wrote. It starts with one empty address. The path is the list strip's label instead of a shell row over both panes, the password's rule ends where the username's does, extras are chips on one row, and pin is a star on the title row.
sheets.before: address "*" wildcard · path row 1032px over both panes · password 403px vs username 478px · 4 stacked + buttons
sheets.after: address empty · path in the list strip @y0 · password rule 478px = username · chips on 2 rows

sheets.title: Settings › General — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Locking was one sentence with two selects inside it. It is two named rows whose selects share one width, like the switches under them.

sheets.title: Settings › General › Keybindings — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: settings/keybindings.yaml showed and demanded JSON. It is written and read as YAML; JSON still reads, because JSON is YAML.

sheets.title: Settings › Vaults — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: The new-vault + stood 24px past its field, under an explainer caption about the personal vault. The + ends its field (the shared field-inline row) and the caption is gone; the missing delete key says it. A vault never sealed no longer claims Locked.

sheets.title: Settings › Security › Formats — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Each format was a 960px row whose read/write marks sat in fractions of the panel, a screen away from its name, with no header. It is a table: Format / Read / Write / Runtime, columns as wide as what they hold.

sheets.title: Connections — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Under Managed every tile said Managed; API Key said API key. A kind is drawn only where heading and name do not say it, names take the brand's spelling (OpenAI, OpenRouter, OpenBao), and each tile ends in the chevron that says it opens a page. Custom connector is a + key.
sheets.before: kind repeated on every Managed tile · no chevron
sheets.after: kind only where it adds · chevron on every tile

sheets.title: Access › Grants — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Access had a path strip of its own whose + opened nothing (its Host ceremony was removed) and pushed its tabs 75px below Identity's. The book's import and export keys end the title row; the Grants tab's + is Identity shares'. "No grants on this device yet" above twelve grants and "Application grants: -" are gone, head keys are one size, and a share's role is on its meta line.
sheets.after: tabs @y99 · import/export in title row · 24px head keys

sheets.title: Vault › New login — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A new login drafted a * wildcard address with its help and tester, and its × was centred across the address and its rule. The address starts empty, the × ends the address's row, the group's + stands over it, and the save row stays at the pane's foot while the fields scroll.
sheets.after: × @y319 on the address row · save row sticky

sheets.title: Connections — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: "Add a connection" wrapped onto two lines beside a / key and a Custom connector word button, and the status line's Support key sat against the glass. The heading is one line, Custom connector is a + key, and the strip keeps its 8px gutter.

sheets.title: Vault, empty — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A phone hid the keyboard tip and left a bare "Nothing here". A keyboard tip with a touch counterpart says that one on a phone.

sheets.title: Access › Identity shares — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Each share's title had 163px beside a role chip, a boxed lock and the trash, so names broke over three lines. The role is on the meta line and the status glyph is unframed.
